changelog:
- Initial release of aeo-citability skill.
- Adds Python 3 script to enhance static sites for answer engine citation (Perplexity, ChatGPT search, Google AI Overviews).
- Provides commands to audit sites, inject JSON-LD schema and FAQ, generate Markdown siblings, create llms.txt, and generate sitemap.xml.
- Works on any directory of .html files, with safe, idempotent operations.
- No dependencies beyond Python 3 standard library.
